# Agent Loom

> Minimal Agent governance runtime: declared evidence gates execution; provenance,
> exact consumption and durable execution facts stay outside model authority.

Canonical repository: https://github.com/tgwrite/Agent_Loom
Documentation target: 0.2.0-alpha.1 pre-release; archive distribution through GitHub Releases.
Runtime integration: Pi. Core remains independent of Pi.
Requirements: Node.js >=24.12.0, npm, ESM. Native dependencies may require more.

## User manual: follow this path

- [Manual index](manual/README.md): 使用手册入口、阅读顺序与验证范围。
- [Install](manual/INSTALL.md): Download or build, verify and install the pre-release archive.
- [Getting started](manual/START_HERE.md): Choose caller/developer/adapter work; run a complete synthetic lifecycle.
- [Call an application](manual/AGENT_API.md): CLI/SDK sequence, request fields, Host binding and artifact selection.
- [Native integration tutorial](manual/NATIVE_INTEGRATION.md): Every file for a real Pi application; default-model setup, native tool execution and output validation.
- [Application and adapter API](manual/ADAPTER_API.md): Descriptors, bindings, hook arguments/returns, artifact inputs and plugin-specific prerequisites.
- [Troubleshooting](manual/TROUBLESHOOTING.md): Diagnose by layer; inspect execution, consumption, aspects and unknown outcomes.
- [Result and independent proof](manual/ADAPTER_API.md#require-a-result-and-independent-proof): Producer constraints and exact subject/digest validation.
- [Advanced contracts](manual/AGENT_GUIDE.md): Schemas, receipts, cooperative locks and version compatibility.

Application users should not need to read framework or test implementation source.
Use the selected native plugin's own documented API for its business protocol;
Loom does not infer undocumented native entries or provide adapters for every package.

## Project and contributors

- [Overview](README.md): Scope and project identity.
- [Chinese overview](README.zh-CN.md): 中文简介。
- [Local installation](manual/INSTALL.md): Candidate archive, checksum and installation instructions.
- [Contributing](CONTRIBUTING.md): Source checkout and development checks.
- [Contributor rules](AGENTS.md): Development, privacy and publication instructions.
- [License](LICENSE): Apache License 2.0.

Loom does not schedule missing producers. Consumption follows successful domain
initialization. Completed execution is not business acceptance. Unknown outcomes
do not establish safe retry. Synthetic examples do not establish native compatibility.
